name: Meera Sharma
description: Elder daughter of the Sharma family. Left for Delhi six years ago without explanation and works as a bank clerk there.

aliases.note: Childhood pet name used only by her mother.
Regional address term for an elder sister; Arjun uses it only once the two reconcile.
Affectionate address by elders; 'beti' means daughter but does not imply parentage.

relationships.note: Deceased six years before the episode.

name: Arjun Sharma
description: Meera's younger brother. Left his engineering course the year she went away and now runs the family's small dairy.

aliases.note: Common affectionate pet name for a boy; elders still use it for Arjun, which he resents.

relationships.note: Addresses him as 'Kaka' out of respect; not a relative.

name: Kamla Sharma
description: Widowed mother of Meera and Arjun. Holds the household together and kept her late husband's letter for six years.

aliases.note: Literally elder brother's wife. Kinship for Raghav; for Bansi it is a courtesy form of address, not kinship.

name: Raghav Sharma
description: Shankar's younger brother; owns a cloth shop in the village market. Presents himself as the family's provider.

aliases.note: Father's younger brother. Distinct from 'Tau' (father's elder brother) and from 'Kaka', which Bansi is called only as an honorific.

name: Bansi Lal
description: The village postman for thirty years. Talkative, warm and scrupulous about postal rules.

aliases.note: 'Kaka' is used here as a respectful address for an older man. Bansi is NOT related to the Sharma family.

name: Shankar Sharma
description: Meera and Arjun's late father, who died six years before the episode. Seen only in a framed photograph and heard only through his letter.
